allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge of the species: about 12 m at 25 years and 25 m at 80. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: fresh green needles, red-brown fibrous bark. Needle shoots (plant roadmap P4): flat leaves 1 to 2 cm long and 1 to 1.5 mm wide, so a needle 0.08 as wide as it is long (`width`), and needles about 1.5 cm on a spray 27 cm long (`needle` 0.055), from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): fibrous reddish-brown bark in long shallow strips; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a deciduous conifer of southern swamps and rivers, 20 to 35 m tall, with soft, feathery two-ranked needles that turn rust in autumn, a strongly buttressed, fluted base and woody knees rising from its roots round it; round cones. Not fitted to measurements. Spray area (plant roadmap P4): the area its card draws with needles of their true length. Conifer form (pinidae revision 5): `branch_reach` fitted so the open-grown crown keeps revision 4's radius at the oldest keyframe.

generator.params.bend_set.note: Conifer sag (M6, bend@1): the share of each year's sag its wood keeps, with `straighten` the share of that bend it straightens each year. Set by eye from renders at 60 to 80 years: with the program's creep (0.5 and 0.02) the bald cypress's thin, slow limbs hang down, so it keeps the milder creep the broadleaf program uses (0.1 and 0.3).

generator.params.dioecious.note: How PlantGen draws the sexes, a choice of the model's (dioecy, 2026-10-14): a plant bears both sexes, unless its taxa state it dioecious.

generator.params.height_max.note: What the conifer and succulent programs' height_max means: the height their Chapman-Richards curve rises toward with age and never reaches, so the tallest the plant grows, the height a flora gives as its greatest ("trees to 40 m"). Plants of a usual age stand below it, as the curve says. Where a flora's greatest is a rare record, the plant grows a little tall; a check of the grown plant against its usual height (spec rework M8) will show it.

generator.params.sex.note: How PlantGen draws the sexes, a choice of the model's (dioecy, 2026-10-14): a plant's sex is its own draw, dealt across a package's seeds so that both sexes grow; the typical plant (sex 0.5) is female, so it shows its fruit.

generator.params.side_years.note: A choice of the model's (conifer form, pinidae revision 5): a side shoot grows for 10 years, not pinidae's 20. Bald cypress sheds its leafy branchlets with their needles each autumn (Abrams 1923 at Taxodiaceae, see the genus), so few side shoots persist and build up as an evergreen's do; with 20 years its open crown at 80 years drew 249,000 segments, two and a half times another conifer's, and its motion rig took 1.9 s. At 10 it draws 115,000 and keeps its reference heights.

generator.params.wood_density.note: Spec rework E6d: the pinidae program's foliage life, cones and needle bundles and ranks from each taxon's stated characters. Conifer sag (M6): green wood's density and stiffness from the Wood Handbook values the species state.

generator.params.wood_modulus.note: Spec rework E6d: the pinidae program's foliage life, cones and needle bundles and ranks from each taxon's stated characters. Conifer sag (M6): green wood's density and stiffness from the Wood Handbook values the species state.

generator.program.note: The conifers' own program (growth plan G2.3a), renamed from `conifer` and homed here: a leader laying down whorls of branches each year, with sprays of foliage and cones.

generator.spreads.params.height_max.note: What the conifer and succulent programs' height_max means: the height their Chapman-Richards curve rises toward with age and never reaches, so the tallest the plant grows, the height a flora gives as its greatest ("trees to 40 m"). Plants of a usual age stand below it, as the curve says. Where a flora's greatest is a rare record, the plant grows a little tall; a check of the grown plant against its usual height (spec rework M8) will show it.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy (plant forms milestone F6). Calibration against measurements and photographs comes later.
